text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the turn of the new year, Mejiro
Bright
enters her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your tutelage proved invaluable
over the
course of last year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to further guidance from
you this
year. It's my honor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not sure whether I responded in the
proper
manner, but our conversation is
still going, so
let's call it good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, resolutions! Well, I do have one in
mind, of
course.
choice_data_list: By the way, Bright, what's your re...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's to perform well at the Classic Triple
Crown
and bring further glory to the
Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright is typically one to take
things slow, but she shows zero
hesitation with her answer. She
can see
her goal as clear as day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I mean to try especially hard at the
Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby, as
neither of those has
yet been won by a
Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, she's right. No
member of the Mejiro family has claimed
victory at either
the Satsuki Sho or the
Japanese Derby yet.
choice_data_list: I see, the Mejiro family still has...
I see, the Mejiro family still has...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If her sights are set on those races...
she might
already have scoped out the
potential
competition, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oooh... My "rivals"?
choice_data_list: We can't lose to our rivals at the...
We can't lose to our rivals at the...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer, but who might you
be
referring to?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It seems she doesn't have her
competition
marked yet. Well, when it
comes to Mejiro
Bright's peers, there's...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So... You're aiming for the Satsuki Sho,
are you,
Bright?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I haven't nailed down my running style
yet.
Hopefully, I'll have a clearer picture
of it in time
for the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka. She's a quiet
Umamusume who
keeps to herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her indecisiveness influences her running
and is limiting her success. Expectations
for her classic
year admittedly aren't the
highest.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I see it! I see all,
Bright! You intend
to run
run run in the Classic races, yes?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I expect a mighty rival will make an
appearance! Well, I'm referring to myself
there, of course.
That's assuming I can
fill those cleats, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru—she's into
fortune-telling
and the supernatural.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks like she's doing her best, but
rumors
abound that she's relying a little
too much on luck
at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, Fukukitaru... We've spoken from
time to
time, but I've only just realized
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We joined the Twinkle Series at the
same time,
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Mejiro Bright, who tends
to march to the beat of her own drum,
only saw those two as conversation
partners. As for her rivals themselves,
though, surprising no one...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I hadn't paid it any mind either. I've
been
focused entirely on refining my
running.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Likewise! I've been devoting all my
efforts to
increasing my luck parameters!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
None of them have pegged the others as 
threats... They're all so busy finding
themselves that they don't have the
headspace to even
consider rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer. Given that it's the
start of a brand-new year, and there are
actually two
individuals I'd like to get to
know better...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think I should choose to
spend time with? There's always the
option of spending the
time alone, of
course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How to spend New Year's with her
peers... What
should I suggest?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that does sound fun. Dear Suzuka, I
wonder if
you wouldn't mind letting me
braid your gorgeous
hair?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've loved braiding since I was a child,
you see...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Braid it? I mean, I wouldn't mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Then let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: La la laaa, la la laaa. ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Bright? You've been at this for a
while. Are
you almost finished?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all.
I'm still brushing your hair.
I've yet
to begin the braiding. ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...So this is going to take quite a while
longer,
then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright makes sure that every
strand of Silence Suzuka's hair is
perfectly in place, and even while having
fun, she grows more patient through the
process as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Admire bonsai alone... Yes, that might
be nice. I
can frolic with my school
friends anytime I like,
after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I must bid the two of you farewell for the
time
being. I'm off to observe the bonsai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tonk... Tonk...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Ahh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright is simply admiring the
bonsai trees
when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer? I've come to a realization...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is said that each bonsai tree is
akin to
a
miniature universe, but upon observing
them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I would posit that they are not universes,
but
trees after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Words fail me. Still, this venture has
definitely
been a soothing one for
Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Play with dolls... Ah, yes, Fukukitaru,
what are
your thoughts on this little
one?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Her name is Maki, and she's ever such a good girl.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! For you to have a doll like this in your possession, Bright, you must be truly devout.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That is your charm—your protection, no?
A doll
that sustains injuries in your stead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, katashiro dolls have been used in
Misogi
purification ceremonies for
millennia...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And this doll has absorbed any and all
calamities
that would have befallen you,
Bright. How
fortunate...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear me. Poor Maki...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright heads to the shrine to hear
some
Shinto teachings and comes away
having learned
a thing or two.
